entities.summary: Byrana Nagappa Suresh is an Indian aerospace scientist. He serves as chancellor of the Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST) in Thiruvananthapuram and is a professor at ISRO Headquarters. B. N. Suresh was a architects & engineers from Karnataka (b. 1943-09-12, Karnataka). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
